title: Run one task on one screen at a time.
subtitle: Attention discipline
rationale: Close everything unrelated to the current task; task switching taxes accuracy and speed even when it feels efficient.

evidence.summary: Task-switching research consistently shows measurable time and error costs from multitasking; single-tasking removes the switch tax.

sources.label: APA research summary on multitasking costs

indications: A second monitor or split screen always carries chat or email.
Tasks finish slower than their actual size explains.
